Name: Maggie SMN Complete
Description: Complete Summoner event profile based on Jasper's public-duty structure and checked against BossMod priorities. Opener stays enabled; Save CD is manual only; Demi, summons, Searing Light, movement helpers and beneficial AoE remain enabled.

Events.Name: Addle & Radiant Aegis
Events.Description: Uses Addle and Radiant Aegis on raidwide damage while in combat.

Events.Name: Zone Reset
Events.Description: Summoner defaults are reapplied after changing zones.

Events.Name: Out-of-Combat Reset
Events.Description: Returns Summoner ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset
Events.Description: Summoner defaults are reapplied after a wipe.

Events.Name: Rekindle MT (<=70% HP)
Events.Description: Holds Rekindle through minor tank chip damage.

Events.Name: Addle Tankbuster
Events.Description: Applies Addle to tankbusters when the target is not already covered.

Events.Name: Radiant Aegis Emergency
Events.Description: Uses Radiant Aegis around 75 percent HP for earlier personal safety outside scripted raidwide handling.

Events.Name: Rekindle Self Emergency
Events.Description: Uses Rekindle on self around 60 percent HP during solo or personal emergency windows.

Events.Name: Damage State Guard
Events.Description: Maintains Summoner AoE, raise, movement, summon, Demi, Searing Light, and support helper toggles in combat so imported or held toggle states cannot strand the job in a passive state.

Events.Name: Pack Damage Release
Events.Description: Maintains standard Summoner AoE, summon, Demi, Searing Light, and movement helper toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Conditions.Name: Target No Addle
Conditions.Description: Target does not already have Addle or equivalent magic damage down.

Conditions.Name: MT HP <= 70%
Conditions.Description: Main tank is at or below 70% HP.

Conditions.Name: Self HP <= 75%
Conditions.Description: Self HP safety threshold for personal mitigation.

Conditions.Name: Self HP <= 60%
Conditions.Description: Self HP threshold for emergency Rekindle recovery.

Logics.Name: Addle & Radiant Aegis
Logics.Description: Uses Addle and Radiant Aegis on raidwide damage while in combat.

Logics.Name: Reset Toggles
Logics.Description: Returns Summoner ACR settings to their normal out-of-combat state, including AoE, raise, summon, movement, and support toggles. ForceAOE remains manual.

Logics.Name: Rekindle MT (<=70% HP)
Logics.Description: Targets the main tank once damage is meaningful.

Logics.Name: Addle TB
Logics.Description: Applies Addle to tankbusters when the target is not already covered.

Logics.Name: Radiant Aegis Emergency
Logics.Description: Uses Radiant Aegis around 75 percent HP for earlier personal safety outside scripted raidwide handling.

Logics.Name: Rekindle Self Emergency
Logics.Description: Uses Rekindle on self around 60 percent HP during solo or personal emergency windows.

Logics.Name: DPS Toggle Safety
Logics.Description: Maintains Summoner AoE, raise, movement, summon, Demi, Searing Light, and support helper toggles in combat so imported or held toggle states cannot strand the job in a passive state.

Logics.Name: Multi-Target AoE Release
Logics.Description: Maintains standard Summoner AoE, summon, Demi, Searing Light, and movement helper toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Items.Name: Opener
Items.Description: Optional automatic opener reset after wipes.

Items.Name: Mitigate
Items.Description: Uses Addle and Radiant Aegis for raidwide, tankbuster, and emergency support.

Items.Name: Rekindle
Items.Description: Uses Rekindle for main-tank and personal recovery support.
